name: Vote Parameters 10
definition: Information describing how the voting process is organised.

SecuritiesQuantityRequiredToVote.name: Securities Quantity Required To Vote
SecuritiesQuantityRequiredToVote.definition: Number of holdings required for a vote.

PartialVoteAllowed.name: Partial Vote Allowed
PartialVoteAllowed.definition: Indicates whether a vote can be on a part of the entire holding, that is, part of the position is un-voted.

SplitVoteAllowed.name: Split Vote Allowed
SplitVoteAllowed.definition: Indicates whether the vote can be split, that is, there could be different votes for different parts of the holding.

VoteDeadline.name: Vote Deadline
VoteDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the vote instructions should be submitted to the intermediary.

VoteMarketDeadline.name: Vote Market Deadline
VoteMarketDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the vote instructions should be submitted to the issuer.

VoteMethods.name: Vote Methods
VoteMethods.definition: Specifies the different methods that can be used to vote.

VotingBallotElectronicAddress.name: Voting Ballot Electronic Address
VotingBallotElectronicAddress.definition: Electronic location, e-mail or URL address, where the voting ballot can be requested.

VotingBallotRequestAddress.name: Voting Ballot Request Address
VotingBallotRequestAddress.definition: Postal address where the voting ballot can be requested.

RevocabilityDeadline.name: Revocability Deadline
RevocabilityDeadline.definition: Date until which the instructing party can revoke, change or withdraw its voting instruction. This deadline is specified by an intermediary.

RevocabilityMarketDeadline.name: Revocability Market Deadline
RevocabilityMarketDeadline.definition: Date until which the instructing party can revoke, change or withdraw its voting instruction. This deadline is set by the issuer.

BeneficialOwnerDisclosure.name: Beneficial Owner Disclosure
BeneficialOwnerDisclosure.definition: Indicates whether beneficiary details, for example, name and address, must be supplied in order to take part in a meeting.

EarlyIncentivePremium.name: Early Incentive Premium
EarlyIncentivePremium.definition: Cash premium paid to the security holder when voting earlier (before the early vote with a premium deadline).

IncentivePremium.name: Incentive Premium
IncentivePremium.definition: Cash premium paid to the security holder when voting.

EarlyVoteWithPremiumDeadline.name: Early Vote With Premium Deadline
EarlyVoteWithPremiumDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the vote instructions should be submitted to the intermediary to take advantage of the early incentive premium.

VoteWithPremiumDeadline.name: Vote With Premium Deadline
VoteWithPremiumDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the vote instructions should be submitted to the intermediary to take advantage of the premium.

VoteWithPremiumMarketDeadline.name: Vote With Premium Market Deadline
VoteWithPremiumMarketDeadline.definition: Date and time by which the vote instructions should be submitted to the issuer to take advantage of the premium.

AdditionalVotingRequirements.name: Additional Voting Requirements
AdditionalVotingRequirements.definition: Additional information on specific requirements for allowing a person to vote.

AdditionalDisclosureRequirements.name: Additional Disclosure Requirements
AdditionalDisclosureRequirements.definition: Information required by the issuer to be disclosed as part of a submitted instruction, that is neither the information related to the beneficiary holder, or the voting participant, or the proxy appointed by the issuer, or the attendee(s) participating to the meeting (without voting).

PreviousInstructionInvalidityIndicator.name: Previous Instruction Invalidity Indicator
PreviousInstructionInvalidityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the previously sent instructions becomes invalid after a market deadline extension.
